summary: Well-structured test suite covering all major requirements with unit tests (semver, commits, changelog, bumper, cli) and end-to-end act harness (4 realistic test cases: feat→minor, breaking→major, fix→patch, no-release). Strengths: comprehensive module-level tests, proper fixtures with beforeEach/afterEach cleanup, workflow structure validation (actionlint), clear test names, machine-parseable CLI output enables reliable assertions. Gaps: BREAKING CHANGE footer is implemented but not tested, no tests for invalid JSON version field or permission errors, act harness uses string matching rather than structured output parsing, missing edge cases (unicode, version 0.0.0, very large numbers), and error messages are only checked for substring containment rather than pattern matching. The act harness itself is well-designed (4 delimited test cases, exact value assertions, job success verification) and would catch most regressions in the release pipeline.
